verdictEs: Mobalytics si quieres editorial completo con build orders, tier lists y planner generalista; Relics.pro si quieres algoritmo dedicado de relic optimization con sugerencias farmeables.
verdictEn: Mobalytics if you want complete editorial with build orders, tier lists, and a generalist planner; Relics.pro if you want a dedicated relic-optimization algorithm with farmable suggestions.

useCases.labelEn: New player looking for clear recommendations
useCases.reasonEs: Mobalytics tiene editorial: tier lists, recommended builds y build orders explícitos por Nightfarer. Relics.pro asume conocimiento previo.
useCases.reasonEn: Mobalytics has editorial: tier lists, recommended builds, and explicit per-Nightfarer build orders. Relics.pro assumes prior knowledge.

useCases.labelEs: Optimizar set de relics para build específica
useCases.labelEn: Optimize relic set for a specific build
useCases.reasonEs: El optimizer de Relics.pro corre algoritmo sobre tu build target y devuelve set óptimo. Mobalytics da recommendations pero no auto-optimiza.
useCases.reasonEn: Relics.pro's optimizer runs an algorithm on your target build and returns optimal set. Mobalytics gives recommendations but doesn't auto-optimize.

useCases.reasonEs: Mobalytics es plataforma multi-juego — una cuenta cubre LoL, Valorant, Nightreign. Relics.pro es Nightreign exclusivo.
useCases.reasonEn: Mobalytics is multi-game — one account covers LoL, Valorant, Nightreign. Relics.pro is Nightreign-exclusive.

useCases.labelEs: Filtrar a relics realmente farmeables in-game
useCases.labelEn: Filter to realistically farmable in-game relics
useCases.reasonEs: Relics.pro filtra obtainability — solo sugiere combinations realmente dropeable. Mobalytics lista todo pero no filtra por feasibility.
useCases.reasonEn: Relics.pro filters obtainability — only suggests truly droppable combinations. Mobalytics lists everything but doesn't filter by feasibility.

useCases.labelEs: Nightlord weakness charts y meta updates
useCases.labelEn: Nightlord weakness charts and meta updates
useCases.reasonEs: Mobalytics mantiene editorial actualizado sobre Nightlords y balance patches. Relics.pro solo cubre relics.
useCases.reasonEn: Mobalytics keeps editorial updated on Nightlords and balance patches. Relics.pro only covers relics.
